description: This Java class defines a rule engine node for pushing messages from edge to cloud in the Thingsboard platform. It extends an abstract push node and includes metadata annotations for configuration and documentation.

classes.name: TbMsgPushToCloudNode
classes.description: A rule node class for pushing messages from edge to cloud, configured via annotations and extending AbstractTbMsgPushNode.
